meta.title: Every new round gets a reference number whose prefix tells its type
gaps: The RFQ title/reference before conversion is not checked because the available verification steps run after the acts and the conversion changes the pricing round.
The numeric running count and proof that the auction receives a fresh number are not exposed as readable fields.
The second event and its higher reference number cannot be created because no available token supplies the productUuid and productQualityUuid required by create_draft.
The forward-auction FA-n reference cannot be created or checked because no setup or operation creates a forward auction.
The show_reference_id gate cannot be set with the available operation fields, so title behavior with display on versus off is not checked.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (show_reference_id) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with a technical (RFP) round and a pricing (RFQ) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
As the buyer, read the technical round and check that Data check: “title” contains RFP-.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “title” contains RA-.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “title” contains RFP-; Data check: “title” contains RA-.
